notes.title: CLIMB QUEST IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
🎉 Climb Quest is officially released! 🎉

I’m beyond excited to finally share this journey with you all! After hard work, dedication, and passion, Climb Quest is ready for you to explore. Ascend through a world of floating islands and overcome challenging platforming in this unique vertical adventure.

Whether you’re climbing solo or with friends, every moment counts as you race to stop the Crystal of Chaos and restore peace to the fractured realm. ⚔️✨

But the adventure doesn't end here! I'm thrilled to share Future Roadmap:

🛠️ Trials Mode – Coming soon! Compete in time-limited challenges where the community races to achieve the best times on unique maps. Test your speed and skill to earn your place on the leaderboard.

🛠️ Chambers of Chaos – A brand-new co-op mode featuring multiple levels filled with traps. Team up with friends and conquer each chamber together in this thrilling new adventure!

Thank you to everyone who has supported me along the way — I can't wait to see how far you'll climb!

🔥 Join the quest, and let the adventure begin! 🔥

--The Creator of Climb Quest--
